memory_candidates.content: When a plan's Scope Hypothesis grep count is exceeded during implementation (more hits than anticipated), the correct move is to fix all discovered hits and record the actual count as a Plan Deviation, not to silently limit the fix to the originally-named files. This is explicit plan-authored guidance, not implementer discretion.
